frontier.hypothesis: An owner grant of the _SANCTIONED_UNWRITTEN_PADS row closes the function immediately; nothing else is outstanding.
frontier.mechanism: The pad form's bytes are proven (full clean build SHA1 == oracle, s7). Only the sandbox scorer, not the real build, is affected by the allowlist row.
frontier.next_probe: Operator path on grant: apply memory/grind/func_80030580/candidate.c's pad form to src/code6cac_b.c via tmp/grind/func_80030580/s1/apply.py, run a fresh layer-2 cheat-reviewer, add the func_80030580 -> frozenset({("pre_pad", 4)}) row to engine/volatile_cheats.py:746, then sandbox reads 0, verify-oracle, queue done.

frontier.hypothesis: There is C from which combine's clause A (death scan crosses a CODE_LABEL) and clause B (substitution leaves the register unreferenced) co-fire, yielding a 13..16-byte untouched alter_reg reservation from semantically real code.
frontier.mechanism: combine.c:10835-10840, guard REG_NOTE_KIND (note) == REG_DEAD && place == 0 && tem != 0. This session proved each clause is independently reachable honestly (f1_wide gives an honest clause-B drop, p110 -> p109 at bodydiff=1; the tbl[0] arm chain supplies clause A by construction) but never observed them co-firing in 22 shapes.
frontier.next_probe: Only worth re-opening on a toolchain finding or a class grant. The mechanical route would be to instrument distribute_notes to log (clause A, clause B) per note and diff the log between the banned self-cancel form pr16_38 (vars=24) and f1_wide (vars=8), isolating what the self-cancel form does to the death scan that an honest drop does not.

frontier.hypothesis: Byte-neutral composables banked over s8/s9 remain free to layer under any future real lever.
frontier.mechanism: Shapes that compile to identical bytes change nothing and can be stacked with a frame-moving construct without cost.
frontier.next_probe: Reuse memory/grind/func_80030580/composable-tblentry-pointer-byte-neutral.c, composable-posptr-byte-neutral.c, the 8 packed-word shapes from s8, and this session's byte-neutral tbl[0] global-indexed and arm mask/shift-identity shapes (tmp/grind/func_80030580/s9/g0a.c, g0ab.c, ar_wideall.c, ar_shlall.c).

Do not resubmit func_80030580 on any /* FAKE */ pad-local route: the phantom-frame-slot family's engine-allowlist prerequisite is owner-granted and unreachable from a grind session. Work state.json frontier item 1 -- an ordinary-C declared frame object of 13..16 bytes that no instruction touches (vars=24, bodydiff<=4, sp=0), measured on the pure-c-floor2-body.c chassis.
